entries.title: Published combined repair expected safe but live recompute left bending failing
entries.root_cause: The combined bending/shear fail family published a resolved repair candidate with an expected post-utilisation below 1.0, and Apply used the resolved payload successfully, but the browser/live post-Apply recompute still reported bending FAIL with final worst utilisation 1.31 while shear passed. The published payload carried bot1_count/db_bot_1 style updates without the row-model mirrors consumed by the live longitudinal reinforcement calculation.
entries.fix_summary: Combined-family repair updates are now canonicalized to emit the approved row-model mirrors, including bot_row_1_bars, bot_row_1_dia, bot_row_2_bars, bot_row_2_dia, and bot_row_count, alongside the legacy count/diameter fields.
